title: 美债回购也压不住？：10年期收益率，创2023年来新高
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I'll flip the board when energy prices rise in such a manner, it is threatening higher yields overall already against the backdrop, of course, of what we're seeing in terms of
segments.zh: 能源价格如此上涨，我预计整体收益率将面临上行压力，尤其是在当前政府支出和企业借贷增加的背景下。

segments.en: the government spending as well as corporate borrowings to come. And it's almost as if, when it comes to yields, there isn't a cap to the upside for them. And this is, of course, coming

segments.en: on a day where we've seen treasuries erase all of their gains since the Treasury Secretary's got best and announced two weeks ago, that expansion of a buyback plan. And not only that,
segments.zh: 此外，10年期收益率也达到2023年以来的最高水平，当时美联储仍在维持高利率。

segments.en: if you look at the yield on the 10-year, it is also at the highest since 2023. And you may recall back then, the Fed was still in the midst of higher for longer. Now, we're also seeing
segments.zh: 交易员在期权市场支付溢价以寻求保护，押注收益率继续攀升，周一有一笔650万美元的押注。

segments.en: traders paying up for protection in the options market, so they are positioning in a way that will benefit if yields continue climbing, including a notable one on Monday,
segments.zh: 该押注认为30年期收益率到11月底可能升至5.7%。我认为全球最大债券市场传递的信号很明确：仅靠回购计划是不够的。

segments.en: six and a half million dollar bet. On the 30-year yield rising to as high as 5.7 percent by the end of November, I think the message is loud and clear from the world's largest bond market
segments.zh: 市场参与者还希望看到美国与外部冲突的持久解决方案，这不仅影响美国国债，也影响G20国家的收益率。

segments.en: that, you know, all this Treasury buyback talk is not going to be enough. And investors also want to see a durable way out of the conflict between the U.S. and around us. And how your yields
segments.zh: 国债回购的讨论不足以解决问题，市场参与者还希望看到美国与周边国家冲突的持久解决方案，以及收益率走向。

segments.en: not just for treasuries, but across the G20 universe, Errol Hanks, thank you so much for that.
segments.zh: 不仅美国国债，整个G20市场都是如此。埃罗尔·汉克斯，非常感谢。
